courses.overview: 以下是有共同物理與介面的延伸課程；每項都指出不可直接照搬的邊界。
courses.overviewEn: These extensions share physics/interfaces; each identifies a boundary that prevents direct copying.

practiceEn: Draw the shared interface for subsea cables, conditioning and interconnection, labeling signals, energy and units.

courses.summary: 本課聚焦潮流可預測性、雙向水流與海洋電力調節。地圖提供公開研究或產業交流的背景；本課的模型和假設不宣稱在該處實測、發明或量產。
courses.summaryEn: This course focuses on predictable tides, reversing flow and marine power conditioning. The map provides public research/industry context; course models and assumptions are not claimed to have been measured, invented or manufactured there.

history.title: 海洋能源測試中心成立
history.text: EMEC 於 2003 年成立，將海洋資源、環境監測和電力測試放在共同場域內。這使原型表現能連到真實電網介面。
history.textEn: EMEC was established in 2003, bringing marine resources, environmental monitoring and electrical testing into a common setting that connects prototype behavior to grid interfaces.

history.title: 潮流場開始運作
history.text: Fall of Warness 潮流測試場於 2006 年開放；官方場址資料描述海纜與岸端調節設施。本課由此討論海洋機組到岸網的介面。
history.textEn: Fall of Warness opened in 2006; official site information describes subsea cables and onshore conditioning. This course uses that context to examine marine-device/grid interfaces.

courses.connection: 從區分潮差與潮流的課程問題出發，依來源追溯研究、元件供應與系統驗證的分工；代表地點不等於完整供應鏈。
courses.connectionEn: Start with distinguish range and stream energy and trace roles in research, components and system validation; the reference location does not represent the entire supply chain.
